% An article with natbib, which sets a bibliography's \itemsep to \bibsep and
% its \parsep to zero (natbib.sty), with entries set close together.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[numbers]{natbib}
\setlength{\bibsep}{0pt}
\begin{document}
Some text, as cited in \cite{book} and \cite{paper}.
\begin{thebibliography}{9}
\bibitem{book} A.~Author. \emph{A Book}. 2000.
\bibitem{paper} B.~Writer. A paper. 2001.
\end{thebibliography}
\end{document}
